parts.title: WRITING TASK 1

WRITING TASK 1

You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The diagram below shows the floor plan of a public library 20 years ago and how it looks now.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

parts.title: WRITING TASK 2
parts.passage:
WRITING TASK 2

You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

In many countries around the world, rural people are moving to cities, so the population in the countryside is decreasing.

Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questions.instruction: Write an essay discussing whether the migration from rural areas to cities is a positive or negative development.
questions.content: Write at least 250 words.
questions.answer: Model answer not provided for Writing tasks.
